The best alternatives to **Bloomerang** in 2026 include **BetterWorld, 4aGoodCause, Little Green Light, Keela, Salesforce/Agentforce Nonprofit, Donorbox, Funraise, Neon One, and Zeffy**—with the right choice depending mainly on your budget, size, and need for customization.[1][2][4][5][6]

Below is a concise comparison to help you pick:

| Tool | Best for | Key strengths vs. Bloomerang |
|---|---|---|
| **BetterWorld** | Small–midsize nonprofits wanting all‑in‑one fundraising with low costs | No platform fees, strong customization, simple data entry, competitive with Bloomerang’s core donor tools.[1] |
| **4aGoodCause** | Small nonprofits focused on online giving & low overhead | Simple donation pages, recurring giving, strong support; pitched as a Bloomerang alternative for small–midsize orgs.[2] |
| **Little Green Light** | Budget‑conscious orgs needing a solid CRM | Lower-cost CRM, good for donor tracking, events, mailings; frequently recommended as a Bloomerang alternative.[2][4] |
| **Keela** | Data‑driven fundraising & automation | Rated a top Bloomerang CRM alternative, with built‑in analytics, automation, and email tools.[4] |
| **Agentforce Nonprofit (Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud)** | Growing orgs needing deep customization | Highly configurable, strong reporting, but more complex than Bloomerang.[4] |
| **Donorbox** | Orgs prioritizing donation forms & online campaigns | Good donation forms, recurring gifts, embeddable widgets; recommended for nonprofits needing flexible online giving.[2] |
| **Funraise** | Donor retention and modern online fundraising | Markets itself as a premier Bloomerang alternative focused on donor retention and digital fundraising tools.[5] |
| **Neon One** | All‑in‑one fundraising & events | Competes directly with Bloomerang with CRM, events, email, and online giving in one platform.[3][6] |
| **Zeffy** | Very budget‑limited orgs (fee‑free model) | Free fundraising platform (donor tips model), good for ticketing, donations, and forms.[6] |
| **Give Lively** | Small orgs needing free digital fundraising | Free online fundraising tools for eligible nonprofits.[6] |

### How to choose the right Bloomerang alternative

When evaluating these options, focus on:

- **Budget & fees**
  - Bloomerang is considered **mid‑range**, starting around **$125/month**.[6]
  - **Lower‑cost / free** options: Little Green Light (budget CRM), Zeffy and Give Lively (free), BetterWorld (no platform fees).[1][2][6]

- **Features you can’t live without**
  - **Core CRM & donor tracking:** Little Green Light, Keela, Agentforce Nonprofit, Neon One.[2][4][6]
  - **Online donation forms & campaigns:** Donorbox, 4aGoodCause, Funraise, BetterWorld, Zeffy, Give Lively.[1][2][5][6]
  - **Automation & analytics:** Keela and Salesforce/Agentforce stand out for advanced reporting and automation.[4]
  - **Events & ticketing:** Neon One, Zeffy, Little Green Light offer built‑in or strong integrations.[4][6]

- **Ease of use vs. power**
  - **Simpler / quick to adopt:** BetterWorld, 4aGoodCause, Donorbox, Little Green Light, Zeffy.[1][2][4][6]
  - **More powerful but more complex:** Keela, Funraise, Agentforce Nonprofit (Salesforce), Neon One.[4][5][6]

- **Support & onboarding**
  - BetterWorld and 4aGoodCause emphasize responsive support for small nonprofits.[1][2]
  - Salesforce/Agentforce may require more technical capacity or a consultant, but offers strong ecosystem support.[4]

If you share your nonprofit’s size, budget range, and top 3 must‑have features (e.g., “email + online giving + events”), I can narrow this down to 2–3 best‑fit Bloomerang alternatives and suggest an evaluation checklist.
